items.source: descriptor - the descriptor for the target method parameter or field
items.translation: descriptor - 目标方法参数或字段的描述符

items.source: Also supports JSR-330's Qualifier annotation if available.
items.translation: 同时也支持可用的 JSR-330 的Qualifier注解。

items.source: This implementation only supports annotations as qualifier types. The default is Spring's Qualifier annotation which serves as a qualifier for direct use and also as a meta annotation.
items.translation: 此实现仅支持注解作为限定符类型。默认情况下，使用 Spring 的 Qualifier 注解，它既可直接用作限定符，也可作为元注解使用。

items.source: The default value annotation type is the Spring-provided Value annotation.
items.translation: 默认值注解类型是 Spring 提供的 `Value` 注解。

items.source: To be considered a candidate the bean's autowire-candidate attribute must not have been set to 'false'. Also, if an annotation on the field or parameter to be autowired is recognized by this bean factory as a qualifier, the bean must 'match' against the annotation as well as any attributes it may contain. The bean definition must contain the same qualifier or match by meta attributes. A "value" attribute will fall back to match against the bean name or an alias if a qualifier or attribute does not match.
items.translation: 要被视为候选者，bean 的 `autowire-candidate` 属性不能设置为 'false'。此外，如果要在该字段或参数上进行自动装配的注解被此 bean 工厂识别为 `qualifier`，则该 bean 必须与该注解及其可能包含的任何属性相匹配。Bean 定义必须包含相同的 qualifier 或通过元属性匹配。如果 qualifier 或属性不匹配，"value" 属性将回退以匹配 bean 名称或别名。

items.source:
This identifies qualifier annotations for direct use (on fields,
method parameters and constructor parameters) as well as meta
annotations that in turn identify actual qualifier annotations.
items.translation: 这标识了用于直接应用（在字段、方法参数和构造函数参数上）的限定符注解，以及反过来标识实际限定符注解的元注解。

items.source:

items.translation: 此 Setter 属性存在，以便开发人员提供自己的（非 Spring 特定的）注解类型，以指示特定参数的默认值表达式。
